titulo.alumno:
«Заголовок и способ подачи материала»
Headlines and how material is presented

intro: A headline selects and highlights certain elements; compare its claim with the full text to detect exaggeration, omission or emotive language.

piezas.titulo: A headline selects and highlights certain elements; compare its claim with the full text to detect exaggeration, omission or emotive language.
texto: A headline selects and highlights certain elements; compare its claim with the full text to detect exaggeration, omission or emotive language.
A question, a quotation or a strong verb can present an interpretation as if it were a confirmed fact.

frases.estudio: Заголовок обещает «полное решение проблемы», но текст сообщает только о запуске пилотного проекта.
frases.alumno: The headline promises to «completely solve the problem», but the text only announces a pilot project.

frases.estudio: В статье уточняется, что программа охватывает три района и будет оценена через год.
frases.alumno: The article clarifies that the programme covers three districts and will be evaluated within a year.

pregunta.texto: What limits the scope of the news?

opciones.texto: It is a pilot project in three districts
opciones.explicacion: The body of the text describes a limited pilot and a later evaluation.

opciones.texto: The problem is already completely solved
opciones.explicacion: This form does not express the relation the question asks about.

opciones.texto: The programme covers the whole region
opciones.explicacion: Check which word governs the case or the structure.

frase.texto: Заголовок обещает «полное решение проблемы», но текст сообщает только о запуске пилотного проекта.

opciones.texto: The headline promises to «completely solve the problem», but the text only announces a pilot project.
opciones.explicacion: It corresponds to the first example.

opciones.texto: The article clarifies that the programme covers three districts and will be evaluated within a year.
opciones.explicacion: That is the translation of the second example.

frase.texto: В статье уточняется, что программа охватывает три района и будет оценена через год

piezas.traduccion: The article clarifies that the programme covers three districts and will be evaluated within a year.
piezas.explicacion: Pay attention to the order of the words and to the grammatical form highlighted.
